scope: Official SEC Q3 2026 unaudited 10-Q, net interest expense (not cash interest paid), 3M and 9M actuals; no interest-rate forecast or trade signal. All amounts USD millions.

IE00B8KQN827.notes: Net interest expense contains offsetting interest income and is already reflected in US-GAAP earnings / operating cash flow, not a standalone cash interest amount. Debt balance includes 3 disclosed components; increased debt cannot solely be assigned to one acquisition.

US92537N1081.notes: Lower net interest expense partly driven by increased interest income and Term Loan repayment; gross debt stress cannot be construed as future net interest costs or cash interest. Debt covers reported current and long-term portions, not leases or all financing.
